summary: Upcoming-bills list that opens offline, remembers paid and part-paid status, and survives a phone change.

evidence.claim: 12 dated complaints (2025-12 to 2026-11) about crashes, lost or reverted paid status, data erased on phone change, no part-payment, across 4 apps (Bills Organizer, Bill Tracker Pro, Bills Manager, Bobby)
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-finance.json (fin-c1; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

scores.note: data-loss and part-payment are capability gaps, not price. Cause of the Sept-Nov crash cluster unverified (one review cites iOS 27). Crowded with budget apps, so the spec must name the differentiator.

history.note: synthetic screen, rank 3 of 3 (ranks 3,3,3, last in every run). Weak signal on ad-tap appeal only; the complaint evidence was the largest in the batch.
